name: photoEvent
description: Production-ready event photo-sharing web app with AI-powered facial recognition. Guests find their photos by uploading a selfie; admins manage events, folders, and bulk uploads.

backend.face_engine: InsightFace (buffalo_l, 512-d embeddings) with fallback to face_recognition (128-d)

layers.routers: HTTP endpoints, request/response validation, auth guards
layers.services: Business logic: auth, events, storage, face recognition, upload orchestration
layers.repositories: DB access layer, isolates SQL/ORM from services
layers.models: SQLModel ORM entities mapped to tables

privacy.guest_selfie: Processed in-memory only; never persisted to disk or cloud. Embedding discarded after search.
